newsitem.title: CANADA: Biovail stock gains on European deal.
newsitem.headline: Biovail stock gains on European deal.

text.p: Shares in biotechnology company Biovail Corp International jumped after a long-awaited announcement on Tuesday of partnerships to distribute its flagship hypertension drug in parts of Europe.
Biovail jumped 2.25 to 40.40 in light trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange. It gained 1-5/8 to 30 on more than 57,000 shares on the American Stock Exchange.
The Toronto-based firm said on Tuesday it signed licensing agreements covering Britain, Ireland and Spain for its drug called Diltiazem, which is known in the United States as Tiazac.
Biovail said that additional European licenses were expected "in the near term."
The stock lost almost 20 percent last week on the Toronto Stock Exchange after it announced strong third-quarter results but failed to unveil a European marketing partnership, analysts said.
In late September. chairman Eugene Melnyk said the firm expected to announce European partners in markets such as Britain, Germany, France, Italy and Spain in coming weeks.
